Metadata.title: MTG Creator
Metadata.description: Build, validate and share your Magic: The Gathering Commander decks, in English and French.

HomePage.title: Build your Commander decks
HomePage.subtitle: Search cards, build your deck around your commander and check that it follows the rules as you go.

search.title: Fast search
search.description: Find any card by name, even with a typo, and filter by color, type or cost.

rules.title: Commander rules checked
rules.description: 100 cards, singleton, color identity, banned cards and Game Changers: errors show up while you build.

stats.title: Deck statistics
stats.description: Mana curve, colors, card types, lands and total price in euros or dollars.

share.title: Import, export and sharing
share.description: Import a list from Moxfield, Archidekt or MTG Arena, export yours and share it with a simple link.

Footer.fanContent: MTG Creator is unofficial Fan Content permitted under the <policy>Fan Content Policy</policy>. Not approved/endorsed by Wizards. Portions of the materials used are property of Wizards of the Coast. ©Wizards of the Coast LLC.
Footer.scryfall: Card data and images provided by <link>Scryfall</link>.

SignUpPage.title: Create an account
SignUpPage.description: Save your decks and find them on all your devices.
SignUpPage.checkEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Click it to activate your account. Remember to check your spam folder.

SignInPage.title: Sign in
SignInPage.description: Sign in to find your decks.
SignInPage.passwordReset: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.

ForgotPasswordPage.title: Forgot your password
ForgotPasswordPage.description: Enter your account's email address and we will send you a link to choose a new password.
ForgotPasswordPage.sent: If an account exists for {email}, we just sent it an email with a reset link. The link is valid for one hour.

ResetPasswordPage.title: New password
ResetPasswordPage.description: Choose your new password. Your other devices will be signed out.
ResetPasswordPage.invalidLink: This link has expired or has already been used.

VerifyEmailPage.title: Email confirmed
VerifyEmailPage.success: Your account is active and you are signed in.
VerifyEmailPage.error: This confirmation link has expired or has already been used. Sign in: if your address is not confirmed yet, we will send you a new link.

SettingsPage.title: My account
SettingsPage.localeHint: Language of the site and of the emails we send you.
SettingsPage.deleteDescription: Deletion is immediate and permanent: your account and all its data will be erased.
SettingsPage.deleteConfirm: I understand that my account will be permanently deleted.

verifyEmail.body: Thank you for signing up to MTG Creator. Confirm your email address to activate your account. The link is valid for 24 hours.
verifyEmail.ignore: If you did not create an account, simply ignore this email.
